items.text: Drop Lydia at Wells Fargo, 3:45–4:15 (drop-off only). Back in time for the 4:45 dinner — eat it, Tuesday runs till 10.
Wind Ensemble chair audition — video submission

Last day to drop a class without a "W"
Census Day — schedule is locked after this

Quiz 1 — Transport Layer (Ch. 3)
ECS Career Fair, 10am–4pm — your fair. Also Sep 23. Resume ready by Sep 15.
Midterm exam — bring your photo ID
Hadestown Rehearsal 8 — all day, not the usual 5–6:30
Quiz 2 — Link Layer (Ch. 6)

Cast photos — all day
Quiz 3 — Wireless and Mobile (Ch. 7)
Quiz 4 — Network Security (Ch. 8)
Course project due
Fill out the Wind Ensemble member information form
See Jacky Trinh in early October to clear the ECS hold — it blocks spring registration, and spring registration is when you apply to graduate
Apply for graduation in Galaxy — it opens the same day spring registration does (late Oct / early Nov). Miss it and there's a late fee.
Order Earl Irons "27 Groups of Exercises" — the flexibility book your routine is missing
Rebuild the resume to one page — needs to be done by Sep 15, before the career fairs
Confirm the rent due date and set up autopay
30-minute money map with Claude — income, rent, utilities, card balance, what's actually left
Discover → Statements → Download Transactions → save the CSV to C:\Life\money\, then say /money
Grading: attendance 5% · quizzes 20% · project 20% · midterm 25% · final 30%. Showing up is literally worth a third of a letter grade.
Prof. Imtiaz Karim holds office hours TuTh 10–11:30am — that's inside your campus gap, same building trip. Free help you're already parked for.
Final exam is December, exact date still TBD on the syllabus
Only CS 4390 is published on Canvas so far — the other four open up as instructors publish them. Say /canvas to re-check.
Quick Advising runs Aug 24–28, 10am–2pm at ECS South 2.502 — first come, 10 minutes, no appointment
Best career-fair window: Wed Sep 23 after your 11:15 class — the floor is open till 4 and you're already on campus. Tue Sep 22 works too in the 9:45–11:30 gap.
The October–November chain: see your advisor → hold cleared → spring registration opens → register AND apply for graduation the same week. Break any link and May 2027 gets complicated.
Ensemble first class Tue 8/25, 7pm, PHY 1.304 — logistics only, no rehearsal, don't bring your own horn
Hadestown rehearsals are Fridays 5:00–6:30 and you are the ride both ways. Friday lift moved to 1:45 so it still fits. The 90 minutes she is in rehearsal are yours — bring the horn or the laptop.
Daily trumpet routine is in the Plan tab. Rest as much as you play; stop when tired. Tuesday ensemble counts as the day’s practice.
Valet trash — bin outside the door 4–6pm (pickup Sun–Thu nights; bins must be IN on Fri/Sat)
Heads up: the 4–6pm valet window collides with your campus days. Mon/Wed you are not home until ~6:15, Tue not until 10, Thu ~7. Sunday is your one reliable trash night — the app puts it there.
Log into Discover, then turn on transaction alerts (email, $0 threshold) — that is what makes daily spending tracking work
Make accounts: Walmart (cheapest, best pickup) + Tom Thumb (closest). Then say /groceries.
Measured from 850 Cecil Dr: Tom Thumb 8 min · Sprouts 8 · Target 9 · Whole Foods 9 · Walmart 10 · Kroger 13 · ALDI 16. Kroger is the far one.
